_comment: Named scopes for `fw svc osm-admin-regen --set NAME`. Each set names a WORKFLOW and its inputs; the runner defaults (strategy/bucket/refresh_after_days/force) are merged in unless the set overrides them. Override this file with FW_OSM_REGEN_SETS_FILE.
_three_paths_comment: ⚠️ THREE DIFFERENT WORKFLOWS BUILD THREE DIFFERENT TIERS, and they key extracts differently. Using the wrong one silently writes to the wrong path: a north-america@4 BuildAdminSet ran 14.2h, reported success, and published 99 state extracts to north-america/<state> instead of north-america/us/<state> - 93 of them duplicating extracts that already existed at the correct path. (1) BuildAdminSetWorkflow derives keys from OSM admin boundaries under a prefix taken from source_region, so a CONTINENT source can only ever key its children directly under that continent. Right for continent -> countries. (2) BuildPlanetExtracts with scope=subnational uses US Census TIGER shapefiles, which CONSTRUCT the key north-america/us/<state> - the only path that produces the US state tier, because osmfr has no per-state polygons and Geofabrik is banned. (3) BuildAdminFanout fans one BuildAdminSet per child across the FLEET, keyed under that child. Right for states -> counties.
_chain_comment: ORDER IS A CORRECTNESS PROPERTY, not a preference. BuildAdminSet downloads its source FROM THE BUCKET, so regenerating a tier from a stale parent writes children with a fresh mtime over month-old data - and sub-regions carry no replication timestamp, so mtime is the only age signal anything has. requires_fresh enforces it.
historic_note: Measured durations: europe@2 3.3h and 9.8h on identical inputs (a 3x spread), central-america@2 0.1h, europe/germany@6 5.2h, north-america@4 14.2h. BuildAdminSetWorkflow is SINGLE-HOST by design; BuildAdminFanout is the one that uses the fleet.

us-states.description: 51 US states via Census TIGER polygons (the ONLY path that keys north-america/us/<state>)
us-states._warning: Cuts from the 20 GB north-america extract, NOT the 92 GB planet: US states only intersect that continent, so it is ~4.4x less I/O and proportionally less RAM per region. A 25-region complete_ways batch over the PLANET OOM-killed a 14 GiB VM on 2026-08-30. The planet is still downloaded/updated first because the continent extract derives from it.

us-counties.description: 3,167 US counties, fanned per-state ACROSS THE FLEET (not one host)

eu-countries.description: European countries from the 40 GB europe extract (completed 9.8h; 462/469 fresh)

na-countries._warning: The 8 keys under north-america/ are ALL third-party downloads at a 2026-07-12 vintage, and four of them - us-midwest, us-northeast, us-south, us-west - are not countries at all but that provider's US census-region splits. No set has ever built this tier, so it has never been refreshed by us. This set cuts canada / mexico / united-states and the territories from our own continent extract; the legacy us-* keys will be left behind and should be RETIRED, not rebuilt - nothing can reproduce them and they duplicate coverage the state tier already provides properly. RUN 2026-09-04: produced exactly 3 - bermuda, canada, greenland - and dropped 9 for lacking a country ISO 3166-2, MEXICO AMONG THEM. So this set does not refresh mexico or saint-pierre-et-miquelon either, and the four us-* keys remain untouched as expected. `expect` is 3, not 10.

russia-districts.description: russia federal districts - VERIFIED TO PRODUCE NOTHING, do not schedule
russia-districts._warning: RUN AND DISPROVEN 2026-09-04. The set's own instruction was to run it once by hand and check the published count before trusting it. Done: five attempts, every one logged 'generated 0 admin_level=3 polygons (dropped 5 without a country ISO 3166-2)'. Russia is ONE country, so its ISO 3166-1 code is on the country and the ISO 3166-2 codes are on the OBLASTS at level 4 - the federal districts at level 3 carry neither, so the guard drops all five and publishes nothing. The 8 objects under russia/ are third-party downloads and this path can never refresh them. If the tier is wanted, try admin_level 4 (oblasts, ~85 units) - a DIFFERENT tier, not a fix for these keys. Left in the catalogue so nobody re-derives this at the cost of another five passes.

rest-of-world.description: All five stale continent country-tiers, one submission each

_merge_defaults_comment: The runner knobs merge into a set's inputs only when listed here, and a set wins on any key it sets explicitly. ⚠️ refresh_after_days defaults to 0 in the FFL, which means NEVER REFRESH — right for resume (a retry must skip what the last attempt finished) and wrong for the weekly cadence. Omitting it made us-counties report '227 extracts published' while publishing zero and leaving the counties 35 days stale (2026-08-31). BuildPlanetExtracts accepts neither refresh knob, so us-states must NOT list them.
_expect_comment: `expect` is the count `fw svc osm-report` compares the store against, and `expect_prefix` overrides where it looks (default: one level under inputs.prefix or inputs.source_region; a '*' segment means 'per child'). Declared rather than parsed out of `description`, because a reworded sentence must not silently switch the report to expecting nothing. A set with no `expect` is REPORTED as unchecked, never assumed complete.
